facts.text: All on-campus undergraduate bachelor's degree-seeking students who begin at Grace Christian University with fewer than 60 transfer credits must complete a 30-credit-hour Bible & Theology Core.

sources.title: Bible & Theology Core - Grace Christian University
sources.quote: For all On-Campus Bachelor degree-seeking students who begin their Grace programs with fewer than 60 transfer credits, the Bible & Theology Core consists of 30 credit hours made up of required Bible and theology courses, along with select upper-division electives.

facts.text: On-campus undergraduate students at Grace Christian University who complete every course in the Bible and Theology Core with at least a C– can elect to declare a second major in Christian Studies.
